dairy.name: Dairy Farming (పాడి పరిశ్రమ / दुग्ध व्यवसाय)
dairy.demandSeasonality: Peak demand during festival seasons (Sankranti, Dussehra, Diwali, wedding season Oct-Feb); lower yield during peak summer (Apr-May).

mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: ₹48 - ₹54/L (ample dry straw & crop residue lowering feed costs)
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: +15% to +25% volume and premium ghee/curd demand during Sankranti & Diwali
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Fat percentage decreases in peak heat; fodder cost spikes +20%

dairy.competitorDensity: Moderate (typically 3 to 6 local milk producers per village cluster; strong absorption by dairy cooperatives like Vijaya, Amul, Mulkanoor, Gokul, Nandini).
keyRisks: Summer green fodder shortage
Fluctuating cattle feed prices
Disease outbreaks (e.g. Foot and Mouth Disease)
Delayed payment cycles from private collection agents
recommendedActions: Secure supply contract with local dairy cooperative
Invest in silage / dry fodder storage before summer
Ensure cattle insurance coverage under Livestock Insurance Scheme

poultry.name: Country / Broiler Poultry (నాటు కోళ్ల / బ్రాయిలర్ ఫారమ్ / कुक्कुट पालन)
poultry.demandSeasonality: High demand weekends and non-fasting months; sharp dips during Shravana and Karthika masam / Navratri.

mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: ₹110 - ₹125/kg (local grain surplus lowers farm-gate feed costs)
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Country chicken spikes to ₹450/kg during New Year, Pongal / Sankranti
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Bird mortality risks elevate in 42°C+ summer; shed temperature control mandatory

poultry.competitorDensity: High for broiler contract farming; Low to moderate for free-range country chicken (Natukodi / Desi Murgi).
keyRisks: High mortality rates in extreme summer heat
Feed price volatility (maize and soya)
Sudden retail price drops driven by commercial integrators
recommendedActions: Focus on indigenous Natukodi breeds with premium margins
Install foggers or sprinkler cooling for summer heat mitigation

kirana.name: Rural Grocery / Kirana Store (కిరాణా & జనరల్ స్టోర్ / किराना दुकान)
kirana.demandSeasonality: Steady baseline throughout year; surges during post-harvest settlement and festive seasons.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Customer credit (Udhaari) requests increase as farmer liquidity tightens before harvest
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Cash recoveries surge by 40-60% as farmers sell produce in mandis
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Festive buying of oil, sugar, sweets, dry fruits peaks in Oct-Jan (+35% sales)
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Beverages, cold drinks, curd and glucose water spike in April-June

kirana.competitorDensity: High (almost 5 to 10 village shops within 1 km radius). Differentiation requires credit management & digital payments.
keyRisks: Uncollected customer credit (Udhaari book defaults)
Overstocking perishable goods
Competition from wholesale weekly haats (Santalu)
recommendedActions: Strict 15-day limit on customer credit ledger
Stock fast-moving regional brands and regional snacks
Adopt UPI QR code payment system for faster settlements

weaving.name: Handloom / Powerloom Weaving (చేనేత / పవర్లూమ్ వస్త్రాలు / हथकरघा एवं बुनाई)
weaving.demandSeasonality: Strong festive and wedding peaks (August through February); monsoon lull.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Wholesale merchants place advance orders before wedding season
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Rural weddings drive local saree sales up by 30%
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Diwali, Dussehra & Sankranti account for 45% of annual revenue
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Focus shifts to raw cotton towels, dhotis, and light dress materials

weaving.competitorDensity: Clustered in specific weaving villages (e.g. Pochampally, Gadwal, Mangalagiri, Sircilla, Solapur, Varanasi). Direct market access beats middlemen.
keyRisks: Raw silk/cotton yarn price spikes
Exploitative master weaver commission margins
Counterfeit powerloom replicas sold as handloom
recommendedActions: Register under Handloom Mark and Weaver Credit Card Scheme
Form direct tie-ups with Dastkar, GoCoop, or regional craft exhibitions

tailoring.name: Tailoring & Boutique (టైలరింగ్ & రెడీమేడ్ / सिलाई एवं बुटीक)
tailoring.demandSeasonality: Extreme surges during marriage season (Nov-Feb) and school reopening (May-June).

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Routine alterations and daily wear orders (steady cash flow)
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Family festive celebrations bring high-margin designer orders
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Stitching rates increase by 25% during peak Diwali, Sankranti & Dussehra rush
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: School uniform bulk stitching contracts secure off-season revenue

tailoring.competitorDensity: Moderate to high. Artisanship, timeliness, and maggam embroidery create strong moat.
keyRisks: Single-person dependency and delivery delays during rush season
Frequent power cuts affecting electric sewing/ironing machines
recommendedActions: Acquire motorized industrial machine with inverter backup
Add computer embroidery / maggam work service for higher margins

agri_processing.name: Agri-Processing & Flour / Spice Mill (పిండి మిల్లు & ప్రాసెసింగ్ / आटा व मसाला चक्की)
agri_processing.demandSeasonality: Post-harvest harvest surges (March-April for Rabi, Nov-Dec for Kharif). Consistent weekly household milling.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Household dry flour milling steady at ₹6/kg
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Massive milling queues as paddy, wheat, and pulses arrive from threshing yards
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Chilli powder pounding and sweet batter milling surge in festive weeks
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Diversify into cattle feed pulverizing and spice packaging

agri_processing.competitorDensity: Low to moderate (usually 1-2 mills per village cluster of 2,000 households).
keyRisks: Voltage fluctuations damaging 3-phase motor
Dust hazard and safety risks without proper ventilation
Seasonal dip during lean agricultural months
recommendedActions: Install automated motor starter with phase preventer
Expand into packaged branded millet flours and turmeric powder

pottery.name: Rural Pottery & Terracotta Clay Craft (కుండల తయారీ / మట్టి పాత్రలు / मिट्टी के बर्तन व टेराकोटा)
pottery.averageDailyVolume: 40 - 150 clay pots / planters / kulhads per week
pottery.demandSeasonality: Extreme summer peak for drinking water pots (Feb-May); massive Diya surge before Diwali & Karthika Masam; rainy season clay drying challenges (July-Aug).

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Demand steady for curd pots and local dairy storage containers
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Grain storage clay urns ordered by farmers post-harvest
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Diwali diya prices jump +60%; summer water pot prices double during heatwaves (₹250/pot)
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Highest sales period for water cooling pots; peak kiln firing before monsoons

pottery.competitorDensity: Low in standard villages; clustered in traditional Kumbhar / Kummari artisanal colonies.
keyRisks: Rainy season drying stoppage and breakage in wet kilns
Plastic container competition eroding everyday clay pot demand
Access restrictions to local lake / pond silt (tank clay)
recommendedActions: Adopt electric motorized potter wheel under KVIC Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
Supply bio-degradable tea kulhads to highway dhabas and railway stalls
Introduce modern terracotta gardening planters for urban nursery sales

carpentry.name: Rural Carpentry & Wooden Implements (వడ్రంగి పని & వ్యవసాయ పరికరాలు / बढ़ईगीरी एवं काष्ठ उपकरण)
carpentry.averageDailyVolume: 2 - 5 custom furniture pieces or agri-tool repairs/week
carpentry.demandSeasonality: Surges in pre-monsoon for agricultural tools & carts; post-harvest wedding house-renovation season (Nov-March).

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Sharp rise in demand for plough handles, leveling planks, and cart axles
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Home renovation and wedding furniture orders surge with farmer cash flow
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Puja mandapams, wooden seating (peeta), and decorative woodwork spike before festivals
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Fabrication of window shutters, beds, and modular school desks

carpentry.competitorDensity: Low to moderate (typically 1 or 2 skilled carpentry workshops per Gram Panchayat).
keyRisks: Timber cost inflation and legal transit permits
Cheaper plastic and pressed steel furniture competition
Workplace injury risk without personal protective gear
recommendedActions: Apply for PM Vishwakarma toolkit incentive (₹15,000 grant + subsidized credit)
Combine traditional timber repair with modern modular ply furniture fabrication

fishery.name: Inland Fishery & Pond Aquaculture (చేపల & రొయ్యల పెంపకం / मत्स्य पालन एवं जलकृषि)
fishery.demandSeasonality: Consistent weekly Sunday and festive peak demand; major surges during post-monsoon harvest; monsoon breeding bans on wild catch boost farm-gate rates.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Fingerling stocking season in July-August; feed costs peak before netting
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Netting season in Dec-Feb; bulk buyers transport live fish to Hyderabad / Kolkata mandis
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Festive weekends and wedding seasons see farm-gate price appreciation of +20%
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Water replenishment critical as pond evaporation increases in April-May

fishery.competitorDensity: Moderate. Water body availability (perennial tank, panchayat lease, or borewell pond) serves as natural barrier to entry.
keyRisks: Oxygen depletion (hypoxia) during cloudy days or power failures
Bacterial and fungal water-borne epidemics
Poaching and bird predation in rural open tanks
recommendedActions: Avail PMMSY (Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana) capital subsidy of up to 40-60%
Install automated solar paddle-wheel aerators to eliminate nighttime oxygen crashes
Secure formal lease agreements on village irrigation tanks (Gram Panchayat Cheruvulu)

auto_repair.name: Two-Wheeler & Tractor Rural Auto Repair (టూ-వీలర్ & ట్రాక్టర్ రిపేరింగ్ / ऑटो रिपेयर व सर्विस)
auto_repair.demandSeasonality: Major agricultural pre-sowing rush for tractor servicing (May-June and Oct-Nov); high bike service traffic around harvest settlements.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Intense demand for tractor rotavator, cultivator, and pump repairs before sowing
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Farmers spend on bike overhauls and vehicle upgrades with harvest cash
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Ayudha Puja / Dussehra vehicle blessing week triggers 100% capacity servicing
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Air conditioner / radiator repairs and water pump mechanic calls

auto_repair.competitorDensity: Moderate (typically 2-3 motorcycle mechanics at main mandal junction). Tractor specialization creates a premium monopoly.
keyRisks: Unpaid mechanic bills from local acquaintances
Capital tied up in unsold slow-moving spare parts
Rapid transition to electric two-wheelers (EVs) without diagnostic tools
recommendedActions: Stock genuine engine oils and high-turnover filters (Bajaj, Hero, Mahindra)
Purchase basic multi-meter and battery testing kit under MUDRA Shishu loan
Offer on-field emergency puncture & tractor breakdown assistance within 5km

street_food.name: Rural Canteen & Street Food / Tiffin Center (గ్రామీణ హోటల్ & టిఫిన్ సెంటర్ / ग्रामीण कैंटीन व टिफिन)
street_food.demandSeasonality: Consistent high daily volume; surges during weekly market days (Santalu), bus stand commute peaks, and festival processions.

mandiPriceTrends.preHarvestRate: Steady daily patronage from agricultural laborers and mandal office goers
mandiPriceTrends.postHarvestSurplusRate: Spike in evening snacks and sweet sales as market yard circulation peaks
mandiPriceTrends.festiveSurge: Jathara and local temple festival crowds multiply turnover 3x to 5x
mandiPriceTrends.leanSummerSeason: Chai sales dip in afternoon heat; buttermilk, lassi, and lemon soda sales double

street_food.competitorDensity: High around bus stands and mandal offices. Cleanliness, hot fresh preparation, and prompt service drive high customer loyalty.
keyRisks: Perishable cooked food spoilage in hot weather
Commercial LPG cylinder and edible oil price spikes
Local health inspection and hygiene compliance
recommendedActions: Enrol under PM SVANidhi micro-credit scheme for street vendors (₹10,000 - ₹50,000)
Use UPI QR code on payment counter to eliminate coin change friction
Introduce seasonal cold refreshments (spiced buttermilk / Majjiga) during summer
